fieldValues.title: Record
fieldValues.description: A Tier 2 instance: a stable instance id bound to an exact Type version, carrying values for that Type's fields. The binding is by `typeId` and `typeVersion`, and it is authoritative — the denormalised `typeNamespace` and `typeName` are convenience hints, and a Record whose hints disagree with the resolved Type is invalid until corrected. Conformance is measured against the version the Record was instantiated under; publishing a new Type version does not migrate existing Records.
fieldValues.notes: A Record may also carry lifecycle state, tags, source references and timestamps. Those are envelope members, governed by the Record schema and not by the Type's projected field schema.
